apps.name: TiebaPure
apps.versionDescription:
## What's included

- Stabilizes Home tab reselection and refresh behavior after scrolling.
- Returning from a thread or search now closes that screen first; the next Home tap refreshes the feed.
- A Home tap during an in-flight refresh returns to the top without creating a duplicate request.
- Bumps the app and Open In extension to version `1.4.15` (build `59`).

## Download

`TiebaPure-v1.4.15-unsigned.ipa` is an intentionally unsigned arm64 IPA for local installation/signing.

- Minimum iOS: `16.4`
- Commit: `5a87225190d6a79b1e3ad3b7d846edd407d416c7`
- SHA-256: `28fbe31e673b1f2769043456324521afd87d04ade8d92d33832e967c19c31123`

CI `ci-ok` passed on PR #86, including unit tests, iOS compatibility checks, UI smoke tests, iPad layout tests, and the Release build.

apps.name: Cilicili
apps.versionDescription:
# CiliCili 1.1.1

- 新增动态「全部、投稿、番剧、专栏、UP」分类，独立保留浏览位置，并支持搜索当前动态账号全部已关注 UP 主。
- 升级动态番剧卡片，点击直接进入对应分集，优化首次进入流程并修复简介及分集信息停留在加载状态的问题。
- 升级个人空间，新增主页概览、收藏夹最新三项内容和三列追番列表，完善公开收藏查看与关注状态显示。
- 新增底部标签显示设置，隐藏入口可从首页右上角访问，仅保留首页时自动隐藏底部栏，并完善首页头像菜单和未读消息提示。
- 新增首页推荐长按反馈与 UP 屏蔽操作，支持管理本地屏蔽名单及账户黑名单。
- 增强收藏夹与稍后再看管理，支持视频多选、批量移动、复制和移除，以及收藏夹创建、编辑、删除与排序。
- 优化视频详情页旋转与清晰度切换的画面衔接，支持 4:3、3:2 等比例在竖屏全宽展示和滚动收缩，简介／评论切换移至底部栏。
- 升级私信会话界面，点击底部「发送电波」打开输入弹窗，修复右滑返回误触刷新和短消息异常换行，并支持在评论弹窗内打开个人空间。
- 优化大图缩放、下拉关闭和多图切换，默认加载 1600px 高清预览、按需查看原图，下载／分享与原图操作分开显示。
- 修复部分评论分页提前停止和失败后无法继续加载的问题，完善楼中楼恢复，统一图文与评论排版，并将图片阴影控制扩展至视频封面。
- 优化搜索页和我的页顶部搜索框，搜索类型与排序集中在同一菜单，同时完善底部渐进模糊、页面返回及视频横屏时的底部栏显示。
- 修复首页冷启动短暂显示旧推荐的问题，加载占位随可见区域调整，避免首屏占位不足。

未签名 IPA 已上传至本次 Release 附件，安装前需由侧载工具签名。

apps.name: Melox
apps.versionDescription:
## English

This MeloX iOS + Apple Watch release was built automatically by GitHub Actions.

### MeloX Website

Visit the [MeloX website](https://melox.luoxe.cn/) for project information and the latest news.

### Download

- `MeloX-iOS-unsigned.ipa`: unsigned iOS package containing the Apple Watch app

### Installation

The IPA is unsigned and must be signed before installation.

### Build Information

- Version: `v1.3.0`
- Commit: `a41ea0e1e1fa69fb543d827b853fe3aff5420951`
- Build: `124`

## 简体中文

这是由 GitHub Actions 自动构建的 MeloX iOS + Apple Watch 发行版本。

### MeloX 官网

访问 [MeloX 官网](https://melox.luoxe.cn/) 了解项目与最新动态。

### 下载说明

- `MeloX-iOS-unsigned.ipa`：包含 Apple Watch App 的 iOS 未签名安装包

### 安装说明

该 IPA 未签名，需要自行签名后安装。

### 版本信息

- 版本：`v1.3.0`
- Commit：`a41ea0e1e1fa69fb543d827b853fe3aff5420951`
- 构建编号：`124`

## What's New / 更新内容

## 简体中文

- 增加了歌手关注与取消关注，以及可搜索的已关注歌手音乐库页面
- 增加了搜索联想与输入补全，可在通用设置中开启或关闭
- 增加了从自建歌单移除歌曲的功能
- 增加了自建歌单删除功能，支持删除前确认
- 增加了新建公开与私密歌单，支持在添加歌曲时直接创建歌单
- 修复了 Apple Music 歌词快速换句时滚动跟不上播放进度的问题
- 修复了 iPad 全屏歌词边缘露出播放器背景、退出按钮被状态栏遮挡的问题
- 修复了歌词跳转后与歌曲播放不同步的问题
- 修复了 EVA 歌词界面进入时未随背景渐入的问题
- 修复了 iPad 播放器收起与展开歌词按钮的尺寸和对齐问题
- 优化了全屏天际歌词的换句动画，衔接更自然
- 优化了搜索分类切换，返回已查看的分类时更快
- 优化了跳转、暂停与重播时的播放进度显示
- 优化了 iPad 播放器，采用桌面端样式的双栏布局与常驻播放控制

## English

- Added artist follow controls and a searchable Followed Artists library page
- Added search suggestions and text completion, with a toggle in General settings
- Added the ability to remove songs from your own playlists
- Added deletion of your own playlists with confirmation
- Added public and private playlist creation, including creating a playlist while adding a song
- Fixed Apple Music lyrics falling behind playback during rapid line changes
- Fixed the player background showing around iPad full-screen lyrics and the exit button overlapping the status bar
- Fixed lyrics falling out of sync with playback after seeking
- Fixed EVA lyrics appearing abruptly instead of fading in with the background
- Fixed the size and alignment of the iPad player's collapse and expand-lyrics buttons
- Improved full-screen Skyline lyrics with smoother transitions between lines
- Improved search category switching so previously viewed results appear faster
- Improved progress display when seeking, pausing, and replaying songs
- Improved the iPad player with a desktop-style two-column layout and persistent playback controls
apps.localizedDescription: MeloX 是一款使用 SwiftUI 原生开发的第三方网易云音乐客户端，采用液体玻璃设计，参考 Apple Music 风格并提供丰富的歌词与播放功能。

- 优化了跳转、暂停与重播时的播放进度显示
- 优化了 iPad 播放器，采用桌面端样式的双栏布局与常驻播放控制

## English

- Added artist follow controls and a searchable Followed Artists library page
- Added search suggestions and text completion, with a toggle in General settings
- Added the ability to remove songs from your own playlists
- Added deletion of your own playlists with confirmation
- Added public and private playlist creation, including creating a playlist while adding a song
- Fixed Apple Music lyrics falling behind playback during rapid line changes
- Fixed the player background showing around iPad full-screen lyrics and the exit button overlapping the status bar
- Fixed lyrics falling out of sync with playback after seeking
- Fixed EVA lyrics appearing abruptly instead of fading in with the background
- Fixed the size and alignment of the iPad player's collapse and expand-lyrics buttons
- Improved full-screen Skyline lyrics with smoother transitions between lines
- Improved search category switching so previously viewed results appear faster
- Improved progress display when seeking, pausing, and replaying songs
- Improved the iPad player with a desktop-style two-column layout and persistent playback controls

apps.name: Pixiv-SwiftUI
apps.versionDescription:
## 新功能

- App 更新弹窗新增“跳过此版本”选项，支持忽略指定版本的自动更新提醒
- （v0.16.1 的新功能）HTTP/3 直连模式，修正此前版本的 403 问题

## 优化

- 优化了一系列图片的加载逻辑，改善了 v0.16.1 的高发热问题。

> 性能优化还有很大空间，但暂时推不动了。有想法的朋友期待你的 PR

## 问题修复

- 修复手动提交搜索后未清空搜索栏输入内容的问题
- 修复全屏查看图片失败时的降级回退逻辑，优先展示已加载的预览图
- 修复 iOS 端在页面切换或应用切入后台后再返回时，登录弹窗意外关闭的问题
